page.notes: The asterisk mark after "quo" in the main text is taken to match the side note "In illo psalmo". The side note is set in small italic type and its line breaks are shown in the scan. "pfecta" is a doubtful abbreviation and is marked [?]. "ficcum" is printed as such. The reference "7.2." may be "7.22" in the original; the last figure is unclear. The short stroke at the foot of the page is a mark, not text, and is left out.
